Subject: Pricing and capacity discussion for upcoming renewal and expansion

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the great partnership this year — Novaplex is planning a product expansion in Q1 that will push our inference consumption up by ~30-40% over the next 12 months. We’re approaching the end of our current term and want to align on a renewal that covers the expanded footprint.

Key asks from our side:
- Can you hold current list rates for the first 6 months of the renewal if we sign an LOI by Nov 20? We need predictable unit economics while our new product launches.
- We’re aiming to convert some of our paygo spend into a committed retainer (targeting a 40% uplift to committed tokens). What level of discount/credits would Redwood provide for that uplift?
- Any one-time onboarding or migration credits for the additional capacity would help our finance team with the year-end model.

I’ve attached a purchase-order stub and our SOC2 questionnaire (we’ll also need KMS and audit log details). Would like to schedule a short call next week (30 min) to walk through options — Thursday or Friday morning PT would work for our procurement and ops leads.

Thanks,
Elena

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Congrats on the launch plan — excited to support Novaplex at scale.

High level response / proposed starting points for the call:

Option A — Commit uplift (preferred operationally):
- Increase committed tokens by 40% for a 12-month term.
- Offer: 10% off the current committed unit rate and a one-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied to first invoice.
- Price hold: we can guarantee current *list* per-token rate for the first 6 months of the new term (after which the tiered pricing applies).

Option B — Lower commit + stronger price hold:
- 25% commit uplift; 6-month hard price hold on the signed list rate, followed by a 3-month phased true-up (10% step). No onboarding credit.

Option C — Short-term bridge (minimal contract change):
- Keep current commit; provide a temporary burst allowance and a $15k credit for migration. Rates would remain on current paygo tiers (no long-term discount).

Operational notes: any credit/onboarding concession needs finance signoff (cc-ing Lauren). Legal will want to review LOI redlines if you plan to lock rates by Nov 20. For SOC2/KMS questions I’ll loop in our security contacts after the call.

Can you confirm availability? I can do Thursday 10/15 at 9:30am PT or Friday 10/16 at 10:00am PT — happy to record the session for your execs.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwoodinference.com

Team — forwarding Novaplex’s ask. Quick internal take before the call:

Summary of external asks:
- Hold list rates first 6 months if LOI signed by Nov 20
- Commit uplift ~40% (they indicated 30-40%)
- One-time onboarding credit request; SOC2 detail request

Constraints/considerations:
- If we offer 10% off committed rate + $25k credit (Option A), margin on the uplift will be tight for first 3 months but we get predictable run-rate and potential post-launch expansion. Finance (Lauren) — do we want to push the onboarding credit to be applied as a retention credit over first two invoices instead of one lump?
- Legal will need to review LOI phrasing around "price hold" — we should limit to list-rate hold and include explicit capacity thresholds and true-up triggers. Karthik, can you confirm expected infra footprint change roughly in GPU-hours equivalence so we can map to appropriate burst pools?

Proposed play for the call: lead with Option A as preferred, but keep Option B as a negotiation fallback. If procurement pushes hard on LOI timeline, escalate to Sales Lead for faster approval.

Attaching my suggested negotiation bullets:
- 10% committed discount for 12 months with 40% uplift
- $25k onboarding credit applied over 2 invoices (50/50)
- 6-month list-rate hold; phased true-up over months 7-9 if usage exceeds committed+20%
- LOI deadline to secure hold: sign by Nov 20; final contract to be executed by Dec 20

Thoughts? I’ll be on the call Thurs 10/15 9:30am PT.

Hannah
